title: Needle replaces Howitzer; sustained firing is observable in Sniper
context: The owner found that common models and effect builders did not ensure common firing duration, bullet density or audio behavior. Slot 7 is explicitly replaced by the latest Needle as a dedicated sniper.
outcome: Pinned three Needle tiers at 722e49d59772597c7addd6db1de1880afd516885, replaced slot 7 and normalized retired links. FX base 6 explicitly migrates v2-v5 packages, retaining seven Sentries and missile edits while installing fresh Needle defaults. Shared firing profiles define three-second Lancer, four-second manual Plasma/Rotor and spool voices; Rotor six-way subdivision preserves tier DPS. Sniper schedules pulses and sustained voices; Sentry/Units reuse held beams and shared timing. Needle uses precision fire without Howitzer splash. Gameplay and manual input remain separate hosts, not a unified combat engine.
alternatives: Prior parity checks tested identity and shots but missed sustained duration/audio; browser tests now measure those behaviors.
Factories, early manual progression and general balance remain proposals.
evidence: npm test: 75 programs passed, including frame-rate trigger counts, preserved Rotor DPS and audio edges.
npm run check passed with FX base 6 and pinned Needle/Sinkhole hashes.
npm run test:browser passed source suite.
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --sniper passed all eight models, sustained lifetimes, live audio, spool edges and draft isolation.
